locations.description: Площадь Седогрива образует юго-западный квартал столицы. На восток отсюда ведут улицы Военного квартала, на север — Соборного. Имя правящей семьи вписано в повседневную географию королевского города.
locations.shortDescription: Юго-западный квартал между Соборным и Военным кварталами.

evidence.quote: The Greymane Court is the southwestern section of Gilneas City. It connects to the Military District to the east, and the Cathedral Quarter to the north. Unlike the majority of the capital, this district is not in ruins but rather in good condition. A secret tunnel known as the Undertaker's Pass connects a house here with Aderic's Repose on the other side of the Northgate River.

evidence.quote: The [Greymane family](/wiki/Greymane_family) rules over all of Gilneas. Their home of [Greymane Manor](/wiki/Greymane_Manor) overlooked the southern region of [Duskmist Shore](/wiki/Duskmist_Shore) and [Duskhaven](/wiki/Duskhaven), and it is located behind the [Queen's Gate](/wiki/Queen%27s_Gate) and [King's Gate](/wiki/King%27s_Gate). This area of Gilneas has since sunk outside of the manor, but once held cottages for the [Crowley](/wiki/Crowley)[2] and the Walden families.[3] [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City) also appears to be explicitly ruled by the royal family.[1]

locations.shortDescription: Северо-восточный торговый квартал у дороги к почтовой станции.

locations.shortDescription: Юго-восточный квартал столицы с укрепленной Каменной тюрьмой.

evidence.quote: **Keel Harbor** is a small harbor in central [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula), west of [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City). It is a quest hub in which the Gilneans give another attempt at repelling the [Horde](/wiki/Horde) invaders. The [worgen](/wiki/Worgen)[adventurers](/wiki/Adventurer) arrive here after the [Battle for Gilneas City](/wiki/The_Battle_for_Gilneas_City), where they regroup with the other survivors and their [night elf](/wiki/Night_elf) allies. After the combined forces have dealt with the Horde reinforcements, they escape from the doomed land to [Darnassus](/wiki/Darnassus).

locations.shortDescription: Кукурузные поля к западу от Темной Гавани, рядом с Фермой Аллена.

evidence.quote: **Hammond Farmstead** was a [farm](/wiki/Farm) located west and downhill of [Duskhaven](/wiki/Duskhaven), in southwestern [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(starting_zone)). [Melinda Hammond](/wiki/Melinda_Hammond) owned the farmstead where she grew corn. Next door, to the south, was [Allen Farmstead](/wiki/Allen_Farmstead). The two properties were divided by an ominous fissure in the ground right before the [Cataclysm](/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)).

locations.name: Деревня Тлеющего Угля
locations.description: Деревня Тлеющего Угля стоит у Реки Северных врат в северо-восточном Гилнеасе. Неподалеку находится одноименная шахта, связывающая поселение с горными выработками. Речная долина помещает деревню между лесистым севером полуострова и его восточными возвышенностями.
locations.shortDescription: Северо-восточная деревня на Реке Северных врат рядом с шахтой.

evidence.quote: Emberstone Village is a village along the Northgate River in northeastern Gilneas. It survived the worgen curse only to be invaded by the Forsaken. locations.name: Грозовой Перевал
locations.description: Грозовой Перевал — небольшая рыбацкая деревня на южной опушке Черной дубравы. За ее домами начинается лес, а жизнь поселения обращена к прибрежным водам. Деревня соединяет морской промысел с дорогами южного Гилнеаса.
locations.shortDescription: Рыбацкая деревня на южной опушке Черной дубравы.

locations.description: Черная дубрава раскинулась южнее города Гилнеаса и севернее Грозового Перевала. В восточной части леса стоит древнее дерево Тал'дорен, а на южной опушке находится Мельница Брэдшоу. Лес образует широкий зеленый пояс между столицей и южными поселениями.
locations.shortDescription: Южный лесной пояс Гилнеаса с Тал'дореном и Мельницей Брэдшоу.

evidence.quote: **The Blackwald** is a forest in southern [Gilneas](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula "Gilneas peninsula") , located south of [Gilneas City](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_City "Gilneas City") and north of [Stormglen Village](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Stormglen_Village "Stormglen Village") .

evidence.quote: Tal'doren, also known as "the wild home", is located in the eastern section of the Blackwald in southern Gilneas. According to Belysra Starbreeze long ago, the tree was home to Druids of the Pack [1] - who later became the original worgen- before they were imprisoned within the Emerald Dream, sleeping under a tree identical to this one, but not before their curse spread to others.[2]
evidence.temporalBasis: Geography/role from saved extraction; precise founding date not independently established.

evidence.quote: **The Bradshaw Mill** is a ruined and abandoned mill located in the southern part of the [Blackwald](/wiki/Blackwald), north of [Stormglen Village](/wiki/Stormglen_Village) in [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula). [Belysra Starbreeze](/wiki/Belysra_Starbreeze) was here waiting for the [worgen](/wiki/Worgen_(playable))[adventurer](/wiki/Adventurer). locations.shortDescription: Древнее дерево и «дикий дом» в восточной Черной дубраве.

evidence.quote: **Gilneas City** (or the **Ruins of Gilneas City**[3] and simply **Gilneas**) was the capital city of the [kingdom of Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)) located in the [peninsula of the same name](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula). It was a dark and foreboding place of narrow cobblestone streets and crowded, Gothic houses, divided into four districts, centered around the [Light's Dawn Cathedral](/wiki/Light%27s_Dawn_Cathedral). Shortly after the [Cataclysm](/wiki/Cataclysm_(event)), the city was struck by a [worgen](/wiki/Worgen) assault and, later, a [Forsaken](/wiki/Forsaken) invasion. After its abandonment by the Gilneans, the [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance) initially managed to retake the city, although it was ultimately left ruined and abandoned.[2]

locations.shortDescription: Мельница на южной опушке Черной дубравы над Грозовым Перевалом.

locations.name: Предел бури
locations.description: Предел бури — прибрежное поселение с маяком на востоке Гилнеаса. Дома стоят на возвышенности над морем, а под скалами лежит каменистый берег. Маяк отмечает этот участок побережья и связывает поселение с морскими путями полуострова.
locations.shortDescription: Восточное поселение на скалах с собственным маяком.

evidence.quote: **Tempest's Reach** is a village and lighthouse on the eastern coast of [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula). It is here that the people of [Stormglen Village](/wiki/Stormglen_Village) fled to. It is also here where [Lord Godfrey](/wiki/Lord_Godfrey) betrayed and captured [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane). Godfrey can be found with Greymane and [Lord Hewell](/wiki/Lord_Hewell) in the center of town, [Baron Ashbury](/wiki/Baron_Ashbury) can be found at the lighthouse, and [Lord Walden](/wiki/Lord_Walden) is in a house up the hill. After his minions are dealt with, Lord Godfrey commits suicide by jumping off the cliff onto the jagged rocks below the village, unwilling to live with a worgen for a king.
evidence.temporalBasis: Geography/role from saved extraction; precise founding date not independently established.

locations.name: Покой Адерика
locations.description: Покой Адерика — кладбище к западу от города Гилнеаса, неподалеку от Килевой гавани. В его центре поднимается мемориальный холм с гробницей Адерика, почитаемого патриарха гилнеасцев. Здесь память о предках соседствует с тихими окраинами королевской столицы.
locations.shortDescription: Кладбище западнее столицы с мемориальным холмом и гробницей Адерика.

evidence.quote: **Aderic's Repose** is a cemetery in [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula) located outside of the city to the west, not far from [Keel Harbor](/wiki/Keel_Harbor) to the north. The [Undertaker's Pass](/wiki/Undertaker%27s_Pass) that begins in [Greymane Court](/wiki/Greymane_Court), crosses under the [Northgate River](/wiki/Northgate_River) and exits in small house in the Repose. [Aderic](/wiki/Aderic) was an unknown [Gilnean](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)) referred to as a "patriarch" (possibly a king).
evidence.temporalBasis: Geography/role from saved extraction; precise founding date not independently established.

evidence.quote: The location is a cemetery with a memorial hill, a gate, and houses. If you follow the hill in the center with the winding path you will come upon a small house, which appears to be a "funeral home".
evidence.temporalBasis: Geography/role from saved extraction; precise founding date not independently established.

evidence.quote: At the top of the hill lies **Aderic's Tomb**. [Liam Greymane](/wiki/Liam_Greymane) was seemingly laid to rest in a coffin in front of it.[2]

locations.name: Лес Северных врат

locations.shortDescription: Северный лес между рекой и дорогой из столицы.

evidence.quote: The **Northgate Woods** is a forested area in [Gilneas](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula "Gilneas peninsula") , located north of [Gilneas City](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_City "Gilneas City") and south of the [Greymane Wall](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Greymane_Wall "Greymane Wall") .

locations.name: Река Северных врат
locations.description: Река Северных врат проходит по Гилнеасскому полуострову от северных лесов мимо Деревни Тлеющего Угля. Она огибает город Гилнеас и земли Покоя Адерика. К морю река выходит через узкий проход между каменистыми мысами.
locations.shortDescription: Река северного Гилнеаса, огибающая столицу и впадающая в море между мысами.

evidence.quote: **Northgate River** is a [river](/wiki/River) found on the [Gilnean peninsula](/wiki/Gilneas_peninsula). It runs from a waterfall coming down the eastern section of the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall), crossing the [Northgate Woods](/wiki/Northgate_Woods) and past [Emberstone Village](/wiki/Emberstone_Village), around [Gilneas City](/wiki/Gilneas_City), to at least [Aderic's Repose](/wiki/Aderic%27s_Repose), and empties into the sea through a narrow area between the [two](/wiki/Northern_Headlands)[headlands](/wiki/Headlands). The [Undertaker's Pass](/wiki/Undertaker%27s_Pass) runs under it, connecting the [Greymane Court](/wiki/Greymane_Court) to Aderic's Repose.[1]
evidence.temporalBasis: Geography/role from saved extraction; precise founding date not independently established.

locations.shortDescription: Северо-западные возвышенности с естественными горными рубежами.

Given that his lands would not have drawn issue with the Crowleys, his territories were likely near Deep Elem Mine; perhaps [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill) itself and the surrounding land, which would have made him subservient to Crowley himself. evidence.quote: **Lordamere Lake** (or **Lake Lordamere**)[1] is one of the largest [lakes](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Lake) in the [Eastern Kingdoms](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Eastern_Kingdoms), rivaled only by [Darrowmere Lake](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Darrowmere_Lake) to the east. Along with Darrowmere, this lake has been marked by many events that took place around it. Here, many [human](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Human) [kingdoms](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Kingdom), at the age of the [Alliance of Lordaeron](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron), that were prosperous, have been found around the lake's shores and nearby mountains, including [Lordaeron](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Lordaeron_(kingdom)), [Dalaran](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dalaran_(kingdom)) and [Alterac](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Alterac_(kingdom)). Lordamere was very likely given its name from the nearby [Capital City](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Capital_City) of the kingdom of Lordaeron which was built on its northern shores and which was named after [Lordain](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Lordain).

evidence.quote: **The Violet Citadel** (or the **Violet Tower**)[1][2] is the main fortress of [Dalaran](/wiki/Dalaran) which housed/houses the [Eye of Dalaran](/wiki/Eye_of_Dalaran), [Chamber of Air](/wiki/Chamber_of_Air), research laboratories and great spell libraries of the [Kirin Tor](/wiki/Kirin_Tor) — the [mage](/wiki/Mage) class of Dalaran. The towering spire raised by [magic](/wiki/Magic) is located the heart of the city.[3] It's majestic spires and great halls, roofed by thick slate the color of lapis lazuli, gave the citadel its name.[4] The mighty structure rose above all else in the city. Its basic form is a huge tower with cone-shaped additions flanking its lower sides, while the sharply pointed tip is surrounded by a circular array kept in place by powerful magic spells.[5]

evidence.quote: The Violet Citadel is the location of the Grand Library.[6] There's a vault below the Violet Citadel where the [Council of Tirisfal](/wiki/Council_of_Tirisfal) trapped the [dreadlord](/wiki/Dreadlord) [Kathra'natir](/wiki/Kathra%27natir) 2,600 years [BDP](/wiki/BDP).[7] The Violet Citadel also contains the [Arcane Vault](/wiki/Arcane_Vault) which houses Dalaran's most powerful artifacts. evidence.quote: At the time of the [Second War](/wiki/Second_War), Lord Crowley was a nobleman whose lands and people were in northern [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), including some land outside of the border that would later be known as the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall). He owned the towns of [Pyrewood Village](/wiki/Pyrewood_Village) and [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill). Despite being young and new to the Gilnean council of Lords, his altruistic and charismatic qualities made him loved by the Gilnean people and earned him the respect and friendship of [King Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane). Crowley was one of the nobles who accompanied Greymane to [Capital City](/wiki/Capital_City) to hear of [Stormwind](/wiki/Stormwind_(kingdom))'s fall and [Anduin Lothar](/wiki/Anduin_Lothar) warning about the invading [Orcish Horde](/wiki/Orcish_Horde). Crowley was sympathetic to the Alliance's plight and advised Greymane to send aid to the newly-formed [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron). Greymane agreed out of self-serving reasons but initially offered only token support.[1]

evidence.quote: Prior to the [Second War](/wiki/Second_War), Godfrey was among the [Gilnean](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)) nobles who accompanied King [Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane) to [Lordaeron](/wiki/Lordaeron) to create the [Alliance of Lordaeron](/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron). Genn trusted his counsel but was always suspicious of his ambitions. Godfrey suggested that to stay in the good graces of their sister kingdoms for the benefit of trade and tariffs, Gilneas should only send a small token force instead of the whole Gilnean army, a sentiment echoed by [Baron Ashbury](/wiki/Baron_Ashbury). Genn noted that unlike [Darius Crowley](/wiki/Darius_Crowley)'s empathetic urge to aid the other human nations, Godfrey's notion was a smart political play that ensured notoriety for himself, as he was the commander of Gilneas' standing militia. However, Genn also saw the wisdom in Godfrey's advice and stated that he would consider it.

evidence.quote: Following the end of the [Second War](/wiki/Second_War), Genn told Godfrey of his intentions of constructing the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall) to seal Gilneas off from the rest of the world. Godfrey pointed out that while Genn was considering building the wall through the lands of [Lord Marley](/wiki/Lord_Marley), constructing it through a mountainous region in Lord Crowley's domain would make for a more secure natural barrier, although doing so would cut off the northern villages of [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill) and [Pyrewood](/wiki/Pyrewood_Village). Genn warned that Darius might not take well to having his lands cut off, but Godfrey insisted that it was the best course of action for Gilneas. The fact that this placement of the wall would make Godfrey's own lands the most strategically valuable — as they would form the realm nearest to the wall and would thus be Gilneas' buffer to the outside — did not escape Genn, but he conceded that Godfrey was right, regardless of his personal motives. As Godfrey finished his goblet of wine, he fought the urge to smile.[4]

[Baron Longshore](/wiki/Baron_Longshore) states that he was once a legitimate baron of Gilneas; though where his lands would have been, or if someone else was given jurisdiction over them, is unknown.

evidence.quote: The [Crowley](/wiki/Darius_Crowley) family ruled over the lands that constituted both [Pyrewood Village](/wiki/Pyrewood_Village) (and as a result, [Shadowfang Keep](/wiki/Shadowfang_Keep)) and [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill),[4] making [Baron Silverlaine](/wiki/Baron_Silverlaine) a vassal of theirs as a result. [Lord Mayor Morrison](/wiki/Lord_Mayor_Morrison) was also the mayor of Pyrewood, placing him implicitly under Crowley's service. [Lord Harford](/wiki/Lord_Harford) was also noted as a servant of Arugal and from beyond the wall, meaning he was likely one of Crowley's vassals as well. The [Marley](/wiki/Lord_Marley) family ruled over an unspecified province near Gilneas' borders, which at the time stretched to about the proximity of the [Deep Elem Mine](/wiki/Deep_Elem_Mine). His lands were deemed ill-suited as they lacked natural boundaries to assist with the wall. Given that his lands would not have drawn issue with the Crowleys, his territories were likely near Deep Elem Mine; perhaps [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill) itself and the surrounding land, which would have made him subservient to Crowley himself. Marley notably remained behind the Greymane Wall in spite of this.

evidence.quote: At the time of the [Second War](/wiki/Second_War), Lord Crowley was a nobleman whose lands and people were in northern [Gilneas](/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)), including some land outside of the border that would later be known as the [Greymane Wall](/wiki/Greymane_Wall). He owned the towns of [Pyrewood Village](/wiki/Pyrewood_Village) and [Ambermill](/wiki/Ambermill). Despite being young and new to the Gilnean council of Lords, his altruistic and charismatic qualities made him loved by the Gilnean people and earned him the respect and friendship of [King Genn Greymane](/wiki/Genn_Greymane). Crowley was one of the nobles who accompanied Greymane to [Capital City](/wiki/Capital_City) to hear of [Stormwind](/wiki/Stormwind_(kingdom))'s fall and [Anduin Lothar](/wiki/Anduin_Lothar) warning about the invading [Orcish Horde](/wiki/Orcish_Horde). Crowley was sympathetic to the Alliance's plight and advised Greymane to send aid to the newly-formed [Alliance](/wiki/Alliance_of_Lordaeron). Greymane agreed out of self-serving reasons but initially offered only token support.[1]

additionalEvidence.quote: **Aderic** was a [human](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Human) who was a [Gilnean](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_(kingdom)) patriarch. He is buried at [Aderic's Repose](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Aderic%27s_Repose) at the top of the hill. When the Gilneans retreated from [Gilneas City](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gilneas_City) through the [Undertaker's Pass](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Undertaker%27s_Pass) and into the Repose, they disturbed the graves of their ancestors, forcing their spirits to rise from their graves. [Krennan Aranas](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Krennan_Aranas) sought his blessing by offering and placing the [Blessed Offerings](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Blessed_Offerings) on his grave in hopes of calming the risen Gilnean spirits. He appears to have accepted the offer as the spirits returned to the grave.[1]
